newsitem.title: LATVIA: Latvian stocks regain some ground, Lode leaps.
newsitem.headline: Latvian stocks regain some ground, Lode leaps.

text.p: RIGA, April 9 (reuter) - Latvian stocks regained some ground on Wednesday and brick maker Lode jumped after news it was expecting better than planned first quarter profits.
Market turnover came to 161,000 lats against 179,000 lats and Rietumu Bank's index added 0.24 percent to 201.09.
On the secondary market, Lode Brick jumped 24 santimes to 2.60 lats and traded 25,300 lats as news about better than expected first quarter results hit the market.
The company's president yesterday told Reuters that the first quarter turnover was double that of the first quarter of last year and that profits were better than planned.
Leading share Unibanka lost a little more ground after paying out its dividends on April 7 although the fall was nowhere as steep as recent days.
It lost just one santime to 3.78 lats on volume of 67,900, the bourse's biggest today.
Rigas Raugs yeast factory remained stable at 3.90 lats on volume of 15,600 lats.
One of the usual secondary list leaders, Daugavpils Chain remained stable at 2.79 lats as it saw 11,600 lats worth of shares change hands.
Kaija, to join the official list soon, was also actively traded with 9,900 lats of volume as its price increased by two santimes to 2.47.
